_comment: Per probe: `checks` = assertions it should RUN (pass or fail); a probe running fewer has quietly stopped asserting, which is what a renamed control inside an `if (await x.count())` guard does. `seconds` = observed runtime, used to size its timeout. Observed with ORCBREW_PACK set. Regenerate with UPDATE_BASELINE=1. export_busy_retry_e2e.js is absent on purpose: it has not been observed under `lein e2e-server-busy`.
